name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-databnf
description: Search the BnF open catalogue: authors, works, editions and links to what is digitised.

environmentVariables.name: BNF_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Identify your own client. The project's own identifier is appended, so the BnF can always reach a person.

environmentVariables.name: BNF_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 3000, which is also the floor.

environmentVariables.name: BNF_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Deadline for one SPARQL query, in milliseconds. Default 60000.

environmentVariables.name: BNF_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Attempts after a busy answer. Default 3.

environmentVariables.name: BNF_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long an answer is kept in memory, in milliseconds. Default 900000. Zero turns the cache off.

environmentVariables.name: BNF_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
